array.string: # Ensure the SSLC MC container is running under colima/Docker. # Docker's --restart=unless-stopped handles crash recovery; # this plist handles the login/reboot case where Docker starts before this plist. export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin STATUS=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' sslc-mc-container-exo3 2>/dev/null || echo "missing") if [ "$STATUS" = "true" ]; then echo "[sslc-mc] Container already running" exit 0 elif [ "$STATUS" = "false" ]; then echo "[sslc-mc] Restarting stopped container" docker start sslc-mc-container-exo3 else echo "[sslc-mc] Container not found — recreating" docker run -d \ --name sslc-mc-container-exo3 \ --restart unless-stopped \ -e ENTITY=sslc \ -e PORT=8081 \ -e DATA_DIR=/data \ -e ERP_DB_PATH=/data/sslc.db \ -e SUPPLY_DB=/data/sslc.db \ -e MRP_DB=/data/sslc.db \ -e SUPABASE_URL="" \ -e SUPABASE_KEY="" \ -p 8081:8081 \ -v sslc-mc-data:/data \ exos-mc:latest fi
